name: after-the-poem
description: An evidence-led observatory for worlds continued from a poem.

scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm test && npm run check && npm run build && npm run evaluate -- validate-contract tests/fixtures/evaluation/attribution && npm run test:ui && npm run test:page && npm run test:release
scripts.test:ui: python3 scripts/atlas.py build --view full && python3 tests/test_ci_build_restore.py -- node tests/ui-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:release: python3 scripts/atlas.py build --target pages && python3 tests/test_ci_build_restore.py -- node tests/release-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:engines: python3 scripts/atlas.py build --target pages && python3 tests/test_ci_build_restore.py -- sh -c "PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSER=webkit node tests/release-smoke.mjs && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSER=firefox node tests/release-smoke.mjs"
